title: RestSharp
description: RestSharp is a simple REST and HTTP API client library for .NET. It provides an intuitive interface for making HTTP requests and deserializing responses.

data.text: RestSharp is a mature HTTP client library that simplifies making REST requests. It handles serialization, deserialization, authentication, and error handling through a straightforward API.

data.title: Making a GET Request

terms.definition: The main client class that manages connections and sends requests.
A request object that defines the URL, method, headers, and body.
Sends the request and returns a response with deserialized data.

data.title: Async by Default
data.text: Always use the async versions of RestSharp methods to keep your application responsive and scalable.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: RestSharp provides a clean interface for HTTP requests
It handles serialization and deserialization automatically
Response.IsSuccessful lets you check for errors easily
data.takeaway: RestSharp is a reliable, easy-to-use HTTP client for any .NET project.

data.title: Exercise: Post Data with RestSharp
data.description: Create and retrieve a resource using RestSharp.
steps: Create a console app and install RestSharp
Build a POST request to https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts with a new Post object
Print the Id returned in the response
Use the returned Id to fetch the created post with a GET request
data.expectedOutcome: You successfully create and retrieve a resource using RestSharp.
